overviewModel.title: Five signals, one league forecast.
overviewModel.description: The model combines what teams have done, the context of the next match and thousands of possible season outcomes. Each step has a clear job.

form.name: Results and recent form
form.description: Completed league matches establish each club's attacking and defensive strength, with recent results carrying more relevance.

context.name: Match context
context.description: Home advantage, time between matches and a cautious starting adjustment for newly promoted clubs shape the baseline.

score.name: Score probability
score.description: Expected goals are converted into chances for each scoreline, a home win, a draw and an away win.

evidence.name: Evidence checks
evidence.description: Additional sources can support the forecast, but only proven, pre-match signals are allowed to change its probabilities.

season.name: Season simulation
season.description: The remaining fixtures are played out repeatedly to estimate the title race, top four and relegation chances.

league.seasonFuturesDescription: Project the complete Premier League season and generate futures for title, top-four, and relegation outcomes.
league.marketsHeroDescription: Turn Premier League probabilities into fair-value contract questions for upcoming matches and the season ahead. No bookmaker margin is applied.
